column1: # Issue #144 item 3: one rule per certified kernel family per production backend.
# Every certified family in vectorization-families.tsv must appear once for every backend, and no
# other family may appear; the audit fails in both directions. `probe_path` is the demangled Rust
# path of the wrapper in tools/miso-engine-vectorization-probes; `generic_argument` is the lane type
# the backend instantiates it at, `-` for a family that is not generic over the lane.
# Classes: vector-arith (floating-point arithmetic at the backend vector width), vector-compare
# (a floating-point comparison at that width), vector-any (any operation on the backend vector
# type), no-float (no floating-point operation at all). Every class additionally forbids scalar and
# narrow floating-point arithmetic, fast-math flags, and math-library calls.
